answer: A concrete method: gate entry with a refundable stake bond whose rewards unlock at glacier speed, so each identity keeps real capital frozen for months. That alone kills cheap swarms, since a thousand fakes means a thousand locked bonds and no quick payout. Trust is earned through logged work, never granted from an ivory-tower assumption of good faith. A falcon-eyed audit layer of randomly assigned peer reviewers then slashes the bond whenever collusion is detected, so farming identities costs far more than the rewards they could ever skim.
